```{r}
require(tibble) # dataframe manipulation
require(readr) # for read_csv()
require(dplyr) # for mutate()
require(tidyr) # for unnest()
require(purrr) # for map(), reduce()
require(edgeR) # for normalization
library(here) # for paths
```

```{r}
# Read in harmonized metadata
mouse_metadata_orig <- readRDS(here("output_data/mouse_data/bulk/mouse_bulk_metadata_harmonized_9-19-26.rds"))

# Rename some of the columns
mouse_metadata <- mouse_metadata_orig %>%
  rename_with(~c("Sample", "BioProject", "Species", "CancerType", "CancerTypeFinal", "Tissue", "CancerSystem"),
              .cols = c("run_accession", "bioproject", "organism_scientific_name", "paipu_cancer_type", "paipu_cancer_type_final", "paipu_tissue_final", "paipu_cancer_system")) 

# Only keep certain columns in the metadata
mouse_metadata <- mouse_metadata %>%
  dplyr::select(Sample, BioProject, Species, CancerType, CancerTypeFinal, Tissue, CancerSystem)

# Check
head(mouse_metadata)
```

```{r}
# Read in mouse raw exp data
mouse_exp <- readRDS(here("output_data/mouse_data/mouse_bulk_exp_clean.rds"))

head(mouse_exp)
```


```{r}
# Only keep exp data for the samples in the metadata
mouse_exp <- mouse_exp %>%
  select(1, # keep the gene col
    any_of(na.omit(mouse_metadata$Sample)))

# Only keep metadata for the samples in the exp data
mouse_metadata <- mouse_metadata %>%
  filter(Sample %in% colnames(mouse_exp))

# Check if metadata and exp data are in the same order and have the same samples
all.equal(unname(mouse_metadata$Sample), unname(colnames(mouse_exp)[-1])) # use for .rds
```

```{r}
nrow(mouse_metadata)
ncol(mouse_exp)
```

## PCA function

```{r}
# Mouse color based on taxonomic group
species_colors <- c("Mus musculus" = "#3B4F7A")
```

```{r}
library(irlba)

plot_folder <- "plots/mouse_data"
```

```{r}
visualize_pca <- function(exp, met, title, sp_colors){
  
  # set Genes as row names
  all_exp_filtered_rem <- exp %>% column_to_rownames("Genes")
  
  # transpose data so samples are rows and genes are columns
  exp_transposed <- t(all_exp_filtered_rem)
  
  # remove genes with 0 variance to plot pca
  gene_var <- apply(exp_transposed, 2, var)
  exp_subset <- exp_transposed[, gene_var != 0, drop = FALSE]
  
  # perform PCA using only the first 2 PCs
  df_pca <- irlba::prcomp_irlba(exp_subset, n = 2, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)
  
  # add metadata
  df <- data.frame(
    PC1 = df_pca$x[, 1],
    PC2 = df_pca$x[, 2],
    Species = met$Species
  )
  
  # plot PCA
  pca_plot <- ggplot(df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = Species)) +
    geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
    labs(
      x = "PC1",
      y = "PC2"
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = sp_colors) + 
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
    )
  
  # save PCA plot
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(title, ".pdf"),
    plot = pca_plot,
    path = here(plot_folder),
    width = 10,
    height = 8,
    device = cairo_pdf
  )
  
  return(pca_plot)
}
```


```{r}
# Plot PCA
raw_pca <- visualize_pca(mouse_exp, mouse_metadata, "Mouse_Bulk_Raw_PCA_9-19-26", species_colors)

```

## Process exp data

```{r}
# Check for NA 
sum(is.na(mouse_exp[-1]))

# Check if there are duplicate genes
sum(duplicated(mouse_exp$Genes))
```

```{r}
# Set Genes as row names
mouse_exp_adj <- mouse_exp %>% column_to_rownames("Genes")

# Calculate sample expression sums
samples_total_exp <- colSums(mouse_exp_adj)

```

```{r}
# Number of samples in the dataset
print(paste0("Number of samples in dataset: ", ncol(mouse_exp_adj)))

# Number of samples where total expression > 0
print(paste0("Number of samples where total expression > 0: ", sum(samples_total_exp > 0)))

```

```{r}
# Get samples whose total expression is zero
zero_samples <- names(samples_total_exp[samples_total_exp == 0])

# Filter out samples where total expression is zero
mouse_exp_adj <- mouse_exp_adj[, !(colnames(mouse_exp_adj) %in% zero_samples)]

# Filter metadata to match
mouse_metadata <- mouse_metadata %>%
  filter(Sample %in% colnames(mouse_exp_adj))

# Check if metadata and exp in the same order
all.equal(unname(mouse_metadata$Sample), unname(colnames(mouse_exp_adj)))
```

```{r}
# Number of genes in the dataset
print(paste0("Number of genes in dataset: ", nrow(mouse_exp_adj)))

# Number of genes where the sum of expression across samples > 0
print(paste0("Number of genes where total expression > 0: ", sum(rowSums(mouse_exp_adj) > 0)))

```

# Filter low quality samples

```{r}
# Calculate the number of expressed genes per sample
nonzero <- colSums(mouse_exp_adj > 0)

# Check the distribution of non-zero genes
summary(nonzero)
```

```{r}
# Plot histogram of number of expressed genes per sample with 50 bins
hist_plot <- hist(nonzero, breaks = 50, main = "Number of expressed genes per sample", xlab = "Count")

```

```{r}
# Save hist boundaries
hist_boundaries <- data.frame(
  bin_left = hist_plot$breaks[-length(hist_plot$breaks)],
  bin_right = hist_plot$breaks[-1],
  count = hist_plot$counts
)
```

```{r}
# Check the low count area (<= 6000) what is it for mouse??
subset_bins <- hist_boundaries[hist_boundaries$bin_right <= 6000, ]
subset_bins
```

```{r}
# Compute differences
subset_bins$diff <- c(NA, diff(subset_bins$count))

# Find the bin with the largest increase in frequency
knee_bin <- subset_bins[which.max(subset_bins$diff), ]

knee_bin
```

```{r}
# Set the cutoff as the left of the bin found
cutoff <- knee_bin$bin_left
cutoff
```

```{r}
# Save plot as pdf
pdf(here("plots/mouse_data/Mouse_Gene_Expression_Sample_Filtering.pdf"), width = 7, height = 5)

# Plot a new histogram with cutoff line
hist_plot <- hist(
  nonzero,
  breaks = 50,
  main = "Non-zero genes per sample",
  xlab = "Count",
  col = "steelblue"
)

# Create red line for cutoff on histogram
abline(v = cutoff, col = "red", lwd = 2, lty = 2)

# Add a cutoff label
text(
  x = cutoff,
  y = max(hist_plot$counts) * 0.9, # put the text a little higher than the tallest bar
  labels = paste("cutoff =", cutoff),
  col = "red",
  pos = 4 # place text to the left of the point (right = 4)
)

dev.off()
```

```{r}
# Number of samples before filtering
ncol(mouse_exp_adj)
```

```{r}
# Only keep samples above the cutoff
keep_samples <- nonzero > cutoff

# Filter exp data
mouse_exp_adj_filtered <- mouse_exp_adj[, keep_samples]

# Number of samples after filtering
ncol(mouse_exp_adj_filtered)
```

```{r}
# Filter metadata to only keep samples in the filtered exp
mouse_metadata_filtered <- mouse_metadata[
  mouse_metadata$Sample %in% colnames(mouse_exp_adj_filtered),
]

# Make exp and metadata be in the same order
mouse_metadata_filtered <- mouse_metadata_filtered[
  match(colnames(mouse_exp_adj_filtered), mouse_metadata_filtered$Sample),
]

# Check
all(colnames(mouse_exp_adj_filtered) == mouse_metadata_filtered$Sample)
```

## Filter lowly expressed genes

```{r}
library(edgeR)

# Create an edgeR object
dge <- DGEList(counts = mouse_exp_adj_filtered)

# Filter lowly expressed genes preserving expression in Species and CancerType
keep_genes <- filterByExpr(dge, group = interaction(mouse_metadata_filtered$Species, mouse_metadata_filtered$CancerType))

# Filter exp to only keep certain genes
mouse_exp_adj_filtered <- mouse_exp_adj_filtered[keep_genes, ]

```

## Normalization (TMM + log2CPM)

```{r}
library(DESeq2) 

# function to normalize RNA-seq data
normalize_rnaseq_tmm <- function(counts_df) {
  counts_df_rem <- counts_df %>% column_to_rownames("Genes")
  
  # create a DGEList from the counts dataframe
  expr <- DGEList(counts = counts_df_rem)
  
  # calculate TMM normalization factors
  expr <- calcNormFactors(expr)
  
  # get the normalized counts in log scale (log2CPM) and adds 1
  exp_norm <- as.data.frame(cpm(expr, log = TRUE, prior.count=1))
  
  # return the normalized data frame
  return(exp_norm)
}

```

```{r}
# Normalize exp data using TMM + log2cpm
mouse_exp_norm <- normalize_rnaseq_tmm(mouse_exp_adj_filtered %>% rownames_to_column("Genes"))

```

## PCA of normalized data

```{r}
norm_pca <- visualize_pca(mouse_exp_norm %>% rownames_to_column("Genes"), mouse_metadata_filtered, "Normalized_Mouse_Bulk_PCA_with_dup_9-19-26", species_colors)
```

## Output simplified and full metadata and exp data (duplicated)

```{r}
# Filter full metadata to only keep duplicated high quality samples
full_metadata_dup <- mouse_metadata_orig[
  match(mouse_metadata_filtered$Sample, mouse_metadata_orig$run_accession),
]

# Check that the full and simplified metadata have the same samples
all(full_metadata_dup$run_accession == mouse_metadata_filtered$Sample)

# Check if the order matches between expr and full metadata
all(full_metadata_dup$run_accession == colnames(mouse_exp_norm))

# Check if the order matches between expr and simplified metadata
all(mouse_metadata_filtered$Sample == colnames(mouse_exp_norm))

```

```{r}
# Save simplified metadata duplicated
saveRDS(mouse_metadata_filtered, file = here("output_data/mouse_data/bulk/simplified_mouse_metadata_9-19-26.rds"))

write_tsv(mouse_metadata_filtered, file = here("output_data/mouse_data/bulk/simplified_mouse_metadata_9-19-26.tsv"))

# Save full metadata duplicated
saveRDS(full_metadata_dup, file = here("output_data/mouse_data/bulk/mouse_metadata_harmonized_9-19-26.rds"))

write_tsv(full_metadata_dup, file = here("output_data/mouse_data/bulk/mouse_metadata_harmonized_9-19-26.tsv"))

# Save duplicated exp data
saveRDS(mouse_exp_norm %>% rownames_to_column("Genes"), file = here("output_data/mouse_data/bulk/mouse_exp_tmm_logcpm.rds"))
```
